craft_notes: Sthāyin: praise of the desire-withdrawn master. Device: comma→dash hold line 1, end-dash→colon landing. Rejected: 'fasting' for hunger — killed: kāmāyatim is longing stretched, not fasting. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: To hunger gathered home, to hankering overlong —
to the moon-wreathed Master, Patron: hail.
l4.sanskrit_cite: upasaṃhṛtakāmāya kāmāyatim atanvate avataṃsitasomāya somāya svāmine namaḥ

reads_against.argmap: To desire-withdrawn, longing-stretched, to-stretching.; To moon-crested, to Soma, to master: bow. → Bow to master Soma, desire withdrawn, moon-crested.
c1_essence: Desire withdrawn, longing stretched, moon-crested master bowed; incapable refuge in all-befriending power.
reads_against.l2: Homage to Soma master — his longing drawn in, desire stretched long, the moon his crest.
l3: To hunger gathered home, to hankering overlong,
to the moon-wreathed Master, Patron — hail.
reads_against.t1: Bow to master Soma — desire withdrawn, longing stretched, moon-crested.
